description: Structural navigation under pressure: find the longest public method in a class large enough that whole-file reads should not be cheaper than reading the symbol table. Tests whether the agent reaches for structural inspection (method index + line ranges) instead of dumping the entire source.
prompt: Look at class `cl_abap_compiler`. Among its public methods, find the one with the longest method body (largest line range). Tell me the method name and the start/end lines.
notes: Stable SAP-standard target. Line numbers verified against an S/4HANA system in 2026-Q2 — re-verify against your system before relying on them; small drifts are normal across releases. If your system shows different numbers, update the needles to your ground truth.
